note: Splits and families are fixed. 'principles', 'bug_note', 'mock_scenario' and 'mock_api_error' are maintainer metadata: never shown to the agent, the extractor or retrieval. solution/ and mock/ are used only for validation and the mock backend; hidden/ is never copied into an agent workspace.

tasks.title: Word counts per window of words
tasks.statement: `textstats.stats.window_counts(text, size)` splits `text` into words and returns, for each consecutive window of `size` words, a dict mapping each word to its count in that window. A word is a maximal run of ASCII letters and apostrophes; words are compared case-insensitively and reported in lower case. The last window may hold fewer than `size` words; empty text gives an empty list; `size < 1` raises ValueError. The helpers `textstats.tokenize.words` and `textstats.tokenize.chunks` must behave as their docstrings state.
tasks.bug_note: words() does not lower-case; chunks() range stop drops the final partial chunk.

tasks.title: First free meeting slot
tasks.statement: Times are integer minutes. A booking is a half-open interval (start, end) occupying every minute t with start <= t < end, so a booking ending at 600 does not conflict with one starting at 600. `booking.calendar.first_free_slot(bookings, day_start, day_end, duration, step=15)` returns the earliest start of the form day_start + k*step such that the slot [start, start + duration) lies within [day_start, day_end) and overlaps no booking, or None if there is none. `booking.calendar.is_free` and `booking.intervals.overlaps` use the same half-open convention.
tasks.bug_note: overlaps() treats touching intervals as overlapping; first_free_slot() range stop excludes the last start that fits.

tasks.title: Leaderboard with tie-breaking
tasks.statement: Scoring events are (player, points, time) tuples in any order. `leaderboard.scores.totals(events)` maps each player to (total_points, time_reached), where time_reached is the largest time among that player's events. `leaderboard.ranking.ranking(events)` returns player names ordered by total points (higher first); players with equal totals are ordered by time_reached (earlier first), then by name (ascending).
tasks.bug_note: totals() keeps the first event's time instead of the latest; ranking() ignores time_reached.

tasks.title: All-or-nothing stock reservation
tasks.statement: `inventory.stock.Stock(quantities)` tracks units on hand per SKU. `reserve(sku, qty)` reserves qty > 0 units and raises ValueError if fewer than qty units are available (reserving exactly the available amount is allowed); `release(sku, qty)` returns reserved units; `available(sku)` is on-hand minus reserved (0 for unknown SKUs). `inventory.orders.OrderBook(stock).place(order_id, lines)` reserves every (sku, qty) line of an order: if any line cannot be reserved, nothing remains reserved for that order, the order is not recorded and ValueError is raised; a duplicate order_id raises ValueError. `cancel(order_id)` releases the order's stock and raises KeyError for unknown orders.
tasks.bug_note: reserve() rejects reserving exactly the available amount; place() leaves earlier lines reserved when a later line fails.

tasks.title: Sliding-window rate limiter
tasks.statement: `ratelimit.window.count_in_window(timestamps, now, size)` counts timestamps t with now - size < t <= now: the window of length `size` ends at `now` (inclusive) and excludes its start. `ratelimit.limiter.RateLimiter(limit, size).allow(now)` accepts a request at time `now` if fewer than `limit` previously accepted requests fall in the window ending at `now`; accepted requests are recorded, rejected ones are not. Calls arrive with non-decreasing `now`.
tasks.bug_note: count_in_window() includes the window start; allow() compares with > instead of >=.

tasks.title: League table ordering
tasks.statement: Matches are (home, away, home_goals, away_goals). `league.matches.results(matches)` maps each team to {"points", "scored", "conceded"}: a win gives 3 points, a draw 1 point to each team, a loss 0; scored and conceded count goals for and against the team. `league.table.standings(matches)` returns team names ordered by points (higher first), then goal difference scored - conceded (higher first), then goals scored (higher first), then name (ascending).
tasks.bug_note: results() adds the away team's own goals to its conceded total; standings() skips goal difference.

tasks.title: Recursive configuration merge
tasks.statement: `settings.merge.deep_merge(base, override)` returns a new dict holding the keys of both: where both values are dicts they are merged recursively, otherwise the override value wins. Neither input is modified, and the result shares no dicts or lists with either input. `settings.loader.load(*overrides)` applies the overrides in order on top of `DEFAULTS`; neither load nor later changes to its result may modify `DEFAULTS`.
tasks.bug_note: deep_merge() mutates and returns base itself; load() returns DEFAULTS itself when there are no overrides.
